# Sertuin Events

> Official first-party information about full-service event planning and management in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.

Sertuin Events plans, designs, coordinates and manages corporate events, destination weddings, elopements, marriage proposals and private celebrations in Punta Cana. Services can include concept development, budgets, venues, suppliers, décor, floral design, rentals, catering, transportation, staffing, production logistics, setup and on-site management.

Sertuin Events is operated by SERTUIN SRL, a registered Dominican company with RNC 132199652. The company serves Punta Cana and coordinates with clients by WhatsApp, telephone and online inquiry forms. It is available 24 hours a day, every day of the year. Specialized partners are coordinated only as part of a complete event experience.

- [Sertuin Events home](https://sertuinevents.com/): Official overview of event types, services, planning approach and contact options.
- Telephone and WhatsApp: +1 829 522 2900
- Email: info@sertuinevents.com

The website pages linked below are the primary source for current published prices, inclusions, event imagery, policies and booking information. Availability must always be confirmed directly with Sertuin Events.

## Punta Cana elopement packages

- [Punta Cana elopement packages](https://sertuinevents.com/punta-cana-elopement-packages/): Official English page with current experience prices, decoration prices, inclusions, legal wedding information, policies and frequently asked questions.
- [Paquetes de elopement en Punta Cana](https://sertuinevents.com/es/punta-cana-elopement-packages/): Official Spanish version of the same service.

### Published elopement facts

- The Private Beach Elopement base experience is US$999 and lasts up to two hours.
- The Private Catamaran Elopement base experience is US$1,299 and includes three hours aboard a completely private catamaran.
- The published catamaran price covers 2 to 10 people. The vessel has capacity for up to 60 people; groups above 10 require a custom quote.
- Both base experiences include private round-trip transportation for two from the Punta Cana area, a professional photographer, bouquet, boutonniere, officiant, a dedicated wedding coordinator and a symbolic wedding certificate.
- Every wedding includes coordinator assistance from reservation through planning and an onsite coordinator on the wedding day.
- The catamaran also includes snacks, fruit, sodas, water, rum, mamajuana, music and snorkeling.
- Couples receive 70 to 100 professionally edited, high-resolution photographs within 48 hours.
- One selected decoration is added to the base experience. Published decoration prices range from US$789 to US$1,399.
- Decorations use premium artificial Real Touch flowers. Every published decoration can be installed on the catamaran except the Tropical Wedding Canopy, which is available only on the private beach.
- Published package prices include a symbolic ceremony. A legal wedding service can be added for US$1,200 after the couple's documents are reviewed and accepted.
- The legal service includes receiving and reviewing documents, scheduling the civil registry appointment, collecting the marriage certificate, apostilling it and shipping the completed certificate.
- A US$200 PayPal deposit reserves the date after availability and the service agreement are confirmed. The deposit is credited to the total and is non-refundable under all circumstances.
- The remaining balance is paid in cash on the wedding day when arriving at the beach or before boarding the catamaran.
- If rain affects the selected time, Sertuin may change the ceremony time, use an available covered location or move the experience to a non-rainy day. Catamaran operation remains subject to the captain's safety decision.
- Sending an inquiry form does not reserve or confirm a date.

## Marriage proposal packages

- [Punta Cana proposal packages](https://sertuinevents.com/proposal/): Official English overview, current packages and prices, inclusions, reservation process, real work and frequently asked questions.
- [Propuestas de matrimonio en Punta Cana](https://sertuinevents.com/es/proposal/): Official Spanish version of the proposal service.

Proposal experiences take place on Sertuin Events' private beach in Uvero Alto. Published proposal prices include private round-trip transportation from the Punta Cana area, private beach access, the selected romantic setup, a celebratory beverage, professional photography, the client's preferred song and on-site coordination.

## Punta Cana gender reveal planning

- [Punta Cana gender reveal planning](https://sertuinevents.com/gender-reveal-punta-cana/): Official English service page with custom planning process, eligible locations, real event imagery, frequently asked questions and quote form.
- [Gender reveal en Punta Cana](https://sertuinevents.com/es/gender-reveal-punta-cana/): Official Spanish version of the same service.

Sertuin Events does not sell preset gender reveal packages. Clients share their idea, date, guest count and preferred location; Sertuin reviews the logistics and provides a custom quote. Planning begins after the quote is approved and the deposit specified in the proposal is submitted. The service can be coordinated at private villas, hotels, resorts, beaches, independent venues or another client-selected location in Punta Cana, subject to property approval, local rules, weather and safety requirements.

- [Punta Cana wedding planner](https://sertuinevents.com/puntacana-wedding-planner/): Destination, South Asian and multicultural wedding planning, current planning packages, process, FAQs and inquiry form.
- [Corporate event planner in Punta Cana](https://sertuinevents.com/event-planner/): Corporate event planning, production, logistics, supplier coordination and on-site management.
- [Birthday celebrations](https://sertuinevents.com/birthday-celebrations/): Custom birthday celebration planning in Punta Cana.
- [Event rentals](https://sertuinevents.com/event-rentals/): Current rental inventory managed by Sertuin Events.
- [Floral design](https://sertuinevents.com/floral-art/): Current floral design options and custom inquiries.
- [Contact Sertuin Events](https://sertuinevents.com/contact/): General event inquiry form and direct contact options.

Grecia Mejía is the lead wedding planner presented by Sertuin Events and has 10 years of experience planning destination weddings in Punta Cana. Wedding planning begins with a discovery meeting, signed agreement and a US$500 deposit, regardless of the planning package selected. The company provides year-round 24/7 planning assistance by WhatsApp, phone and email.
